quizzes.question_text: Without using a calculator, choose the statement that best describes the value of $$\sqrt{45}$$.
quizzes.question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
choices: The value of $$\sqrt{45}$$ is between 6 and 6.5.
The value of $$\sqrt{45}$$ is between 6.5 and 7.
The value of $$\sqrt{45}$$ is between 7 and 7.5.
The value of $$\sqrt{45}$$ is between 7.5 and 8.
solution: We want to make all the values comparable. So either we compare all values as square roots, or all values after calculating their square roots. $$\\[0.5em]$$ The square root in this problem is $$\sqrt{45}$$. To compare with actual values, we want to approximate what number multiplied by itself gives 45 (this is the definition of square root).

Test numbers by multiplying integers with themselves: $$\\[0.5em]$$ $$5 \times 5 = 25$$ (too small) $$\\[0.5em]$$ $$6 \times 6 = 36$$ (too small) $$\\[0.5em]$$ $$7 \times 7 = 49$$ (too big) $$\\[0.5em]$$ $$8 \times 8 = 64$$ (way too big)
Narrow it down - since 45 is between 36 and 49. The number we are looking for is between 6 and 7.
There is no option between 6 and 7. So we need to narrow even further. Is it between 6 and 6.5, or between 6.5 and 7?
Let's first test to see if it's between 6 and 6.5. $$\\[0.5em]$$ $$6.5$$ multiplied by itself $$6.5 \times 6.5 = 42.25$$
42.25 is less than 45 so $$\sqrt{45}$$ must be between 6.5 and 7 (This matches answer B)
